tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Peptide designation and properties.
footnotes: Underlined and bold amino acids are D-enantiomers. All linear peptides are amidated in their C-terminus.
Calculated by dividing the net charge by the total number of amino acids.
The peptides were eluted in 40 min using a linear gradient of acetonitrile (AcN) from 30 to 70% v/v in water containing TFA (0.05% v/v) on a C4 reverse analytical column.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC90) towards GBS strains mutated in various cell surface components.
footnotes: The MIC (µM) of each antimicrobial peptide is an average of triplicate measurements performed by a dilution method in 96-well polypropylene microplate. Plates were incubated overnight at 37°C and were then read at OD600 nm for bacterial growth. The MICs90 was considered to be the peptide concentration that inhibited growth of 90% of the tested strains.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Aggregation and membrane interaction of CAMPs with GBS.
footnotes: Percentage of change in signal intensity relatively to the basal signal of the peptides.
Difference in the signal change between dltA strain to the WT strain.
Value is significantly different from that of the WT strain (P<0.05).
Data are means of triplicate measurements from two independent experiments.
